title: Simon 7.3.3(2), corrected (13): a point flat at arbitrarily small scales has a tangent plane
statement: For all n, k, ℓ ∈ ℕ with ℓ ≤ k and n ≥ 1, all sets U, N ⊆ ℝ^{n+k} and every T ∈ 𝒟_n(U) such that U is open, N is an embedded C² (n+ℓ)-dimensional submanifold (IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 2 (n + ℓ) N), (closure N ∖ N) ∩ U = ∅, T is minimizing in U ∩ N (IsMinimizingIn T (U ∩ N)), spt T ⊆ U ∩ N and ∂T = 0 in U (BoundaryVanishes T), and every x ∈ spt T: if x is flat at arbitrarily small scales, i.e. for every β > 0 and every R > 0 there are ρ with 0 < ρ < R and an n-dimensional linear subspace Q ⊆ ℝ^{n+k} such that |(y − x) − p_Q(y − x)| < βρ for every y ∈ spt T with |y − x| < ρ (p_Q the orthogonal projection onto Q, Lean `Q.starProjection`), then T has a tangent plane at x (HasTangentPlaneAt T x: some tangent cone C of T at x, a ConvergesWeakly-limit of blowUp T x λ_j with λ_j > 0, λ_j → 0, has support an n-dimensional linear subspace).
lean_statement: ∀ (n k ℓ : ℕ), ℓ ≤ k → ∀ (U N : Set (Euclid (n + k))) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n), 1 ≤ n → IsOpen U → IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 2 (n + ℓ) N → (closure N \ N) ∩ U = ∅ → IsMinimizingIn T (U ∩ N) → T.support ⊆ U ∩ N → BoundaryVanishes T → ∀ x ∈ T.support, (∀ β : ℝ, 0 < β → ∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R → ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ρ < R ∧ ∃ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid (n + k)), Module.finrank ℝ Q = n ∧ ∀ y ∈ T.support, dist y x < ρ → ‖(y - x) - Q.starProjection (y - x)‖ < β * ρ) → HasTangentPlaneAt T x
